description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Data utilities] Converts a value between units exactly, with rational factors from NIST SP 811 and HB 44 (inch = 0.0254 m, pound = 0.45359237 kg, US gallon = 231 in3): length, area, volume (US and imperial), mass, temperature, time, speed and data size (kB vs KiB). Returns the exact fraction, a decimal, the factor and its source. Input: value (decimal, 1e6 or 1/3), from, optional to (default all), decimals. Offline.

decimals.description: Decimal places in "value", 0-30 (default 12); "fraction" is always exact

from.description: Unit of the value, e.g. mi, km, lb, kg, F, C, GiB, MB, gal, l, mph, acre (symbols or names)

to.description: Target unit of the same kind, or all (default): every unit of that kind

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

value.description: Number to convert: decimal (12.5), scientific (1e6) or fraction (1/3), up to 100 characters

name: unit_convert

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Unit converter with exact factors (NIST SP 811) ($0.002/call)
